changes.before: Gives you a 70% chance to avoid interruption caused by damage while casting Arcane and Nature spells.
changes.after: Gives your Arcane and Nature spells a 70% chance to not lose casting time when you take damage.

changes.before: Increases the damage done by your Frost spells by 6%.
Improves your chance to hit with Frost and Fire spells by 5%.
changes.after: Improves your chance to hit with Frost and Fire spells by 6%.

changes.before: Increases the Armor and resistance given by your Frost Armor and Ice Armor spells by 30%. In addition, gives your Frost Ward a 20% chance to reflect Frost spells and effects while active.
changes.after: Increases the Armor and resistances granted by your Frost Armor and Ice Armor spells by 30%, gives your Frost Ward a 20% chance to negate the warded damage spell, and increases the amount absorbed by your Ice Barrier and Frost Ward by 20%.

changes.before: Instantly shields you, absorbing 431 damage. Lasts 1 min. While the shield holds, your spellcasts will not be interrupted or delayed from taking damage.
changes.after: Shield yourself, absorbing ? damage and increasing your Frost damage by 3% for 1 min. While shielded, your Frost damage is increased by an additional 3% and you do not lose casting time when you take damage.

changes.before: Gives you a 100% chance to avoid interruption caused by damage while channeling Arcane Missiles and a 70% chance while casting Arcane Blast or Arcane Wrath.
changes.after: Gives your Arcane Missiles spell a 100% chance and your Arcane Blast and Arcane Wrath spells a 70% chance to not lose casting time when you take damage.

changes.before: Gives your Arcane Blast spell a 40% chance, your Arcane Missile hits a 10% chance, and your Arcane Wrath, Fireball, Frostbolt, and Frostfire Bolt spells a 20% chance to reduce the channeled duration of your next Arcane Missiles spell by 50%, reduce the Mana cost by 100%, and missiles fire every 1.0 sec.
changes.after: Gives your Arcane Blast spell a 40% chance, and your Arcane Wrath, Fireball, Frostbolt, Frost Blast, and Frostfire Bolt spells a 20% chance to reduce the channeled duration of your next Arcane Missiles spell by 50%, reduce the Mana cost by 100%, and missiles fire every 1.0 sec.

changes.before: Gives your Frost damage spells a 100% chance to apply the Winter's Chill effect, which increases the damage done by your Cone of Cold spell to the target by 40%, stacking up to 5 times.
changes.after: Gives your Frostbolt, Frost Blast, and Fingers of Frost empowered Ice Lance spells a 100% chance to apply Winter's Chill, increasing the target's damage taken from your next Cone of Cold by 5% and it gains an additional 35% of your spell damage, stacking up to 5 times.

changes.before: Increases your spell damage by up to 30% of your Intellect.
changes.after: Increases your spell damage by up to 60% of your Intellect.

changes.before: Gives you a 70% chance to avoid interruption caused by damage while casting any spell.
changes.after: Gives your spells a 70% chance to not lose casting time when you take damage.

changes.before: Reduces the pushback suffered from damaging attacks while casting Lightning Bolt, Chain Lightning, and Lava Burst by 70%.
changes.after: Gives your Lightning Bolt, Chain Lightning, and Lava Burst spells a 70% chance to not lose casting time when you take damage.

changes.before: Gives you a 70% chance to avoid interruption caused by damage while casting any healing spell.
changes.after: Gives your healing spells a 70% chance to not lose casting time when you take damage.

changes.before: Increases the effect of your next Curse of Weakness or Bane of Agony by 50%, or your next Curse of Exhaustion by ?%.  Lasts 30 sec.
changes.after: Increases the effect of your next Curse of Weakness or Bane of Agony by 50%, or your next Curse of Exhaustion by 20%.  Lasts 30 sec.

changes.before: Gives you a 70% chance to avoid interruption caused by damage while channeling or casting your Drain Life, Drain Mana, Drain Soul, or Wrack spells.
changes.after: Gives your Drain Life, Drain Mana, Drain Soul, and Wrack spells a 70% chance to not lose casting time when you take damage.

changes.before: Gives you a 70% chance to resist interruption caused by damage while casting or channeling any Destruction spell.
changes.after: Gives your Destruction spells a 70% chance to not lose casting time when you take damage.
